name: calc_loan_amortization
description:
Fixed-payment loan schedule: monthly payment from the annual rate (rate/12 per month), total paid, total interest and a per-year split of principal and interest. Computed locally in Python; no API key or network.
Returns {principal, monthly_payment, total_paid, total_interest, months, yearly_schedule}: yearly_schedule is [{year, principal, interest, balance}] (empty above 1200 months). An MCP Apps view charts the schedule in clients that support it.
Inputs (* required): principal* (loan amount), annual_rate* (percent; 0 gives straight-line repayment), months* (integer term).
For growth of savings use calc_compound_interest.
Example: {"principal": 300000, "annual_rate": 6.5, "months": 360}
